lines.en: Here we are. This is the art museum.
It's so big, Grandma! Where do we go first?
lines.ko: 엄청 커요, 할머니! 먼저 어디로 가요?

lines.en: First, let's get tickets at the door.
Do many visitors come here?
Yes. Last week a thousand visitors came.
lines.ko: 네. 지난주에는 방문객이 천 명이나 왔어요.

lines.en: Wow! Which hall has the new exhibition?
The map says the big hall on the left.
Can I see the paintings on that wall?
lines.ko: 저 벽에 있는 그림들을 봐도 돼요?

lines.en: Yes, we will see them after the exhibition.
lines.ko: 네, 전시회를 본 다음에 볼 거예요.

lines.en: Thank you, Grandma. This is fun!
Excuse me. Where does the exhibition start?
It starts in this hall, Ma'am. Then go left.
lines.ko: 이 전시실에서 시작해요, 손님. 그다음 왼쪽으로 가세요.

lines.en: Is the gallery collection on this floor?
Yes. The collection is on the far wall.
lines.ko: 네. 소장품은 저쪽 끝 벽에 있어요.

lines.en: I visited this museum ten years ago.
lines.ko: 십 년 전에 이 박물관에 왔었어요.

lines.en: Welcome back! Many things changed after that.
lines.ko: 다시 오신 걸 환영해요! 그 후로 많은 것이 바뀌었어요.

lines.en: Will the exhibition be open tomorrow too?
Yes, it will be open all week.
Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Enjoy the gallery, Ma'am.
